public class Main {
	public static void main(String[] args) {
		BigInteger MOD = BigInteger.valueOf(998244353);
		Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
		long n = sc.nextLong();
		long m = sc.nextLong();
		long L = sc.nextLong();
		long R = sc.nextLong();
		long k = R - L + 1;
		if ((n * m) % 2 == 1) {
			BigInteger exp = BigInteger.valueOf(n * m);
			BigInteger base = BigInteger.valueOf(k);
			System.out.println(base.modPow(exp, MOD));
		} else {
			long e = (R / 2) - ((L - 1) / 2);
			long o = k - e;
			BigInteger E = BigInteger.valueOf(e);
			BigInteger O = BigInteger.valueOf(o);
			BigInteger exp = BigInteger.valueOf(n * m);
			BigInteger a = E.add(O).modPow(exp, MOD);
			BigInteger b = E.subtract(O).modPow(exp, MOD);
			System.out.println(a.add(b).multiply(MOD.add(BigInteger.ONE)).divide(BigInteger.valueOf(2)).mod(MOD));
		}
	}
}
